annotations.pda_responsibility: whatever happens next traces back to how I weigh it right now
that's a choice I made with eyes open, not bad luck, and I'd own that fully
Whatever I decide, send or hold, is mine to answer for
Sending first puts the outcome partly in my hands
The responsibility for what happens sits with me
whatever comes of it traces to my own read of the situation
not going to pretend the outcome would be some accident
something I'll have chosen with full awareness of the risk
It's on me either way, the call is mine
